description: A 6HP blank panel carrying the alef's bits logo

inputs.text: Rotates the logo, 36 degrees per volt

menu: contrast — a slider setting the brightness of the panel, 0.1 to 0.9, the panel and its lettering inverting below 0.4
use global contrast — makes this panel follow the brightness shared by every alef's bits module, in place of its own
set global contrast — copies this panel's brightness into the brightness shared by every alef's bits module
